# Derby Pest Control

> Local pest control company serving Derby and the surrounding Derbyshire and South Derbyshire area. Fixed-price, same-day treatment for residential and commercial customers, covering rats, mice, squirrels, wasps, ants, cockroaches, fleas, carpet beetles, cluster flies, moths and bed bugs.

Derby Pest Control is a local, BPCA-standard operation, not a national call centre. Prices are confirmed on the phone before booking, technicians are local to Derby, and visits are discreet and unmarked. The site covers residential pest control, commercial pest control and EHO compliance, property pest inspections, and dedicated coverage pages for Derby and 28 surrounding towns and villages.

## Services

- [Rat Control](https://derbypestcontrol.co.uk/rat-control/): Fixed-price rat treatment, survey, tamper-resistant bait, included follow-up visit.
- [Mouse Control](https://derbypestcontrol.co.uk/mouse-control/): Mouse treatment for homes and businesses, species identification, entry-point proofing.
- [Squirrel Control](https://derbypestcontrol.co.uk/squirrel-control/): Legally compliant, humane squirrel trapping and loft proofing.
- [Wasp Nest Removal](https://derbypestcontrol.co.uk/wasp-nest-removal/): Same-day wasp nest treatment, most nests cleared in one visit.
- [Ant Control](https://derbypestcontrol.co.uk/ant-control/): Garden and pharaoh ant treatment, indoor and outdoor nest sources.
- [Cockroach Control](https://derbypestcontrol.co.uk/cockroach-control/): German and Oriental cockroach treatment for homes and commercial kitchens.
- [Flea Treatment](https://derbypestcontrol.co.uk/flea-treatment/): Whole-property flea treatment covering carpets, furniture and pet areas.
- [Carpet Beetle Treatment](https://derbypestcontrol.co.uk/carpet-beetle-treatment/): Treatment for wool carpets, clothing and upholstery damage.
- [Cluster Fly Control](https://derbypestcontrol.co.uk/cluster-fly-control/): Seasonal loft and roof space treatment for autumn cluster flies.
- [Moth Control](https://derbypestcontrol.co.uk/moth-control/): Clothes moth and pantry moth treatment.
- [Bed Bug Treatment](https://derbypestcontrol.co.uk/bed-bug-treatment/): Discreet whole-room bed bug treatment, heat and spray options.
- [Pest Inspection](https://derbypestcontrol.co.uk/pest-inspection/): Property pest surveys for buyers, landlords and letting changeovers.
- [All Services](https://derbypestcontrol.co.uk/services/): Full list of services grouped by pest type.

## Commercial

- [Commercial Pest Control](https://derbypestcontrol.co.uk/commercial/): Scheduled contracts, EHO and food hygiene compliance, documented visit reports for restaurants, food retail, warehouses, landlords and offices.
